column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each subscription and availability tier in the system.

Enumerated subscription tier type from: 'free' (free content), 'subscriber' (paid subscriber content), 'current' (currently available content), 'free_on_web' (web-only free content), 'subscriber_on_device' (device-specific subscriber content), 'auth_on_web' (web authentication required), 'showtime' (Showtime premium content).
